title: REPORT OF SUCCESSION TO AN INSTRUMENTATION BUSINESS
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Form 11] <Amended 2012.5.31>

REPORT OF SUCCESSION TO AN INSTRUMENTATION BUSINESS
(TRANSFER AND ACQUISITION, MERGER, OR INHERITANCE)

I hereby report succession to the instrumentation business (transfer and acquisition, merger, or inheritance) pursuant to Article 24(1) and (3) of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act, Article 13 of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and Article 10(1) of the Enforcement Rule of that Act.

Year _____ Month _____ Day _____

Reporting person ____________________ (Signature or seal)

To: Mayor/Do Governor

ATTACHMENTS

Documents to be submitted by the reporting person:
1. Common documents
(a) A list of the technical personnel employed and their construction technology career certificates (only where verification of practical experience is necessary).
(b) A specification of the instrumentation equipment and copies of performance inspection reports for that equipment.
(c) Instrumentation business registration certificate.
2. Documents for the specific type of report
(a) Transfer and acquisition report: A copy of the contract.
(b) Merger report: A copy of the merger agreement, the public announcement of the merger, and a copy of the resolution of the general meeting or other body that resolved on matters concerning the merger.
(c) Inheritance report: Documents capable of proving that the person is an heir.

Matter to be verified by the public official in charge:
Confirmation of the acquisition of national technical qualifications.

Fee: None

CONSENT TO THE JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION

I consent to the public official in charge verifying the matters listed above for official verification, in connection with the processing of this matter, through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 of the Electronic Government Act.
* If consent is withheld, the applicant shall submit the relevant documents directly.

Reporting person ____________________ (Signature or seal)

210 mm × 297 mm [white woodfree paper, 80 g/m²]
